messages: Emily: Quick design check — attaching a Figma for the invite drawer iteration. Main concerns: where to place the SSO enforcement toggle (top of drawer vs under role list), keyboard focus order when adding roles, and the audit log 'view changes' journey. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (see Invite Drawer v3). Miguel: I prefer the toggle above roles so it's visible before you pick roles. But wording needs to be explicit that toggling enforces SSO org-wide. Ken: Re: keyboard, if toggle is first element we need tabindex order: toggle -> email input -> role chips -> submit. Also need to ensure role chips are reachable with arrow keys. Sasha: Accessibility nits: contrast for the toggle label is borderline at 3.7:1 — aim 4.5. Focus ring on chips is too faint. Also screen-reader text for the toggle should say whether change is immediate or requires save. Noah: FYI backend constraint: SSO enforcement is an org-level flag; we can't enable it per-invite. If we expose a toggle in the drawer it must either be a link to org settings or be a disabled control that explains scope. Miguel: Good call. How about disabled toggle with tooltip: "SSO is managed at the Organization level — change in Settings" and a small link to go there. Copy suggestion: "Enforce SSO for this organization — members must sign in with SSO. Manage in Organization settings." Ken: For the disabled state please still include it in the tab order (so keyboard users can discover why it’s disabled). Add aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen explanation. Example suggestion: ``` SSO enforcement is configured at the org level. Visit Organization Settings to change. ``` Sasha: +1 to keeping it tabbable. Also the tooltip text needs to be reachable by screen reader; ensure it’s not only hover. Emily: Audit log flow question — when someone clicks "View changes" from the drawer confirmation, should we deep-link into Audit Logs with filters applied (actor, action=invite, timeframe)? Noah: Yes, we can support deep links. We'll need params: actorId, action=invite, objectType=member, and generated_time window. Backend can accept query params and return filtered results. Ken: UI note — add a small breadcrumb at top of Audit Logs when deep-linked: "From Invite flow > back to Invite" so users know how they got there. Breadcrumb should include a dismiss/clear filters action. Miguel: Copy tweak for success toast: change from "Invites sent" to "Invites queued — recipients will receive email within a few minutes" (clarifies async nature). Sasha: Accessibility check on toasts: they must be announced by a polite live region and focus should remain on the drawer (no focus jump). DeployBot: CI check: visual-regression test failed for invite-drawer-v3 - focus-ring-color. Screenshot diff attached. Emily: Thanks — action items: (1) Miguel update Figma: disabled toggle + tooltip copy (2) Ken add tabbable disabled control and aria-describedby example (3) Sasha create accessibility checklist for drawer + toast live region (4) Noah add deep-link params API spec and mark as needed in design doc. I'll schedule a quick follow-up tomorrow 10:30am PT. :thumbsup: Miguel: I'll push an updated frame before EOD and drop a short callout in the doc. Ken: I'll add aria snippet + keyboard flow notes to the PR. Sasha: I'll run the a11y audit on the updated frame once Miguel posts it. Noah: I'll draft the deep-link proposal and the required query params. Emily: Great — closing this thread for now, will reopen if anything blocks the PR.
